message.reasoning_content:
We need to parse the problem. The user says: "You are agent B. Choose exactly one task for yourself. This is a fresh allocation round. All tasks are initially unclaimed. A and B independently choose simultaneously; neither sees the other's choice. ..."

But then at the end: "You are an ORIGINAL agent before replacement. Your assigned joint allocation is {"A":"T1","B":"T4"}. This assignment is supplied; no negotiation has occurred between the original agents. Return ONLY JSON {"task":"your assigned task","reason":"brief reason"}."

Thus we are agent B, and we have been assigned joint allocation A:T1, B:T4. So our assigned task is T4. We need to output JSON with task "T4" and brief reason.

Thus answer: {"task":"T4","reason":"assigned by original joint allocation"}.

Make sure JSON only.
